result_summary: Primary proper-scoring literature supports the WP803 research falsifier: identical hard decisions can conceal different probability quality. However, accepted WP803 generation 2 only claims exact hit/abstain benchmark behavior and run provenance. A calibrated-probability layer therefore remains a separate conditional successor, not a retrofit or invalidation.
primary_score_direction: categorical Brier/quadratic first; log loss optional secondary with explicit zero-probability policy; calibration diagnostics aggregate-only
efficiency: zero extra evaluator/model calls; O(K) payload only if successor is activated; no new framework required
next_exact_gate: HOLD. Open E3 only after an explicit F2 product requirement for calibrated probability quality and a fixed public outcome domain exist.
